## Added

- Automatic Russian and English interface selection based on the language chosen in Hello Neighbor.
- Live language switching without restarting the game.
- English mod-manager labels, CursorMenu description, control settings and error messages.
- Installer messages that follow the Windows display language.

## Fixed

- The Mods entry no longer stays in Russian when the game uses English.
- Language detection reads Hello Neighbor's own setting instead of relying on Unreal Engine's culture, which can differ from the game's displayed language.
- Existing error messages change language with the rest of the interface.

## Verified

Switched Russian → English → Russian in the running game and checked the manager, CursorMenu description and Mouse/Keyboard settings. Localization and ABI checks pass.

## Compatibility

The supported game build and ABI remain unchanged. Other game languages use the English loader interface.
